items.symptoms: I have red, itchy bumps all over my body. They're especially bad on my arms and legs. I also have a headache and a fever. I don't feel like eating anything and have lost my appetite.
items.note: The failure resulted from prioritizing systemic symptoms over the specific morphology of the rash, missing that widespread, pruritic, vesicular lesions are hallmark signs of varicella. Next time, prioritize the specific character of the skin lesions (e.g., vesicles vs. macules) as the primary diagnostic anchor, using systemic symptoms only as supporting context.

items.symptoms: I have a rash on my face and near my nose. It's been there for a few days and it's starting to spread down my arms and legs.
items.note: The error stemmed from over-relying on the spread pattern while ignoring the specific facial/nasal location, which is a hallmark of impetigo. Next time, prioritize localized bacterial signs like nasal involvement over general viral spread patterns when distinguishing between these conditions.

items.symptoms: I have a high fever, chills, nausea, and severe itching. I also have a headache and am sweating a lot. I have muscle aches and nausea.
items.note: The failure resulted from over-weighting 'severe itching' as a dengue-specific marker while under-weighting the classic malaria triad of cyclical chills, high fever, and profuse sweating. Next time, prioritize the specific pattern of cyclical chills and sweating as primary indicators for malaria, treating itching as a non-specific or secondary symptom unless accompanied by other distinct dengue markers like retro-orbital pain.

items.symptoms: I've been having diarrhea and constipation, which is really bothering me. I have a really bad stomachache, and I'm always tired and don't want to eat.
items.note: The failure occurred because I incorrectly prioritized localized GI symptoms over systemic signs like fatigue and anorexia, which are hallmarks of systemic infections like typhoid rather than localized peptic ulcers. Next time, prioritize systemic constitutional symptoms (fever, profound fatigue) over isolated abdominal pain when distinguishing between infectious and structural gastrointestinal diagnoses.

items.symptoms: I have rashes on my chest and back and I itch all over my body. I sometimes have flaky skin, which often leaves marks on my body.
items.note: The failure resulted from over-weighting the 'flaky' descriptor as pathognomonic for psoriasis while ignoring the generalized nature of the rash and itching, which are hallmarks of systemic drug reactions. Next time, prioritize the distribution pattern (generalized vs. localized) and acute onset over specific surface textures when evaluating widespread dermatological complaints.

items.symptoms: I have been experiencing a lot of belly pain and constipation. I also feel like I need to vomit, and I am feeling very weak.
items.note: The error stemmed from incorrectly assuming typhoid always presents with diarrhea, ignoring that constipation is a common early symptom of typhoid fever. Next time, recognize that typhoid can present with constipation and systemic weakness, not just diarrhea.

items.symptoms: I have a lot of stomach pain, and it's hard for me to sleep. I also feel really anxious and have no appetite.
items.note: The failure occurred because I prioritized stress-related symptoms over the specific nature of the pain, overlooking that peptic ulcers often present with epigastric pain, anorexia, and sleep disturbance due to nocturnal acid secretion. Next time, prioritize the specific location and timing of abdominal pain (e.g., epigastric, nocturnal) over non-specific psychological symptoms when distinguishing between GERD and peptic ulcer disease.

items.symptoms: I've been feeling really grumpy and gloomy lately, and I've also noticed a change in my vision. I think it might be a migraine.
items.note: The failure resulted from over-relying on textbook definitions of migraine while ignoring the patient's explicit self-diagnosis and the validity of prodromal symptoms like mood and visual changes. Next time, prioritize the patient's stated suspicion and recognize that migraines often present with non-headache prodromal symptoms, rather than dismissing them due to the absence of pain.

items.symptoms: I've been having trouble breathing, coughing a lot, and feeling exhausted. I have a fever and have been coughing up a lot of thick, sticky mucus. I'm just so tired and worn out from dealing with this.
items.note: The failure resulted from over-weighting fever and purulent sputum as exclusive indicators of infection, ignoring that asthma exacerbations can present with these symptoms due to concurrent viral triggers or mucus plugging. Next time, prioritize the primary complaint of dyspnea and consider asthma as a leading differential for respiratory distress even when infectious signs are present, rather than defaulting to pneumonia.

items.symptoms: I've been feeling really sick lately. I've been having a lot of nausea and vomiting, and I've lost my appetite. I've also been feeling really weak.
items.note: The failure occurred because I over-relied on the presence of weakness and anorexia while ignoring the absence of hallmark Dengue symptoms like high fever and severe myalgia, which are critical for differentiation. Next time, prioritize the presence of specific pathognomonic signs (e.g., sustained fever for Typhoid) over non-specific constitutional symptoms when distinguishing between similar febrile illnesses.

items.symptoms: I have small red bumps on my arms and face. They are itchy and make my day very uncomfortable.
items.note: The failure resulted from over-relying on the absence of systemic symptoms to rule out chickenpox, ignoring that early-stage presentations can lack fever. Next time, prioritize the specific morphology of vesicular lesions in itchy rashes as a primary indicator for chickenpox, regardless of systemic symptom presence.

items.symptoms: I have a stuffy nose and nasal congestion. I sometimes have a stiff neck and chest discomfort at night. I can't taste or smell anything.
items.note: The failure resulted from over-weighting nasal congestion and anosmia as exclusive viral markers while ignoring the chronic, non-infectious nature of the symptoms and the absence of systemic signs like fever. Next time, prioritize differentiating allergic rhinitis from viral infections by assessing symptom duration, triggers, and the lack of acute systemic illness.

items.symptoms: I've been vomiting a lot and I'm not hungry. My muscles, joints and back hurt all the time. I'm starting to have a fever too. I'm really worried and not sure what to do.
items.note: The error stemmed from incorrectly assuming vomiting is less prominent in Dengue than Typhoid, ignoring that severe myalgia and arthralgia are hallmark Dengue symptoms. Next time, prioritize the specific pattern of severe musculoskeletal pain combined with fever as a primary indicator for Dengue, rather than relying on gastrointestinal symptom hierarchy.

items.note: The failure resulted from prioritizing systemic symptoms over the specific dermatological presentation of intense pruritus, which is the hallmark of varicella. Next time, prioritize the specific quality of the rash (e.g., intense itching) over general systemic complaints when differentiating viral exanthems.
